about: The airport is 5 km from the centre of Cheboksary, address: 1 I. F. Skvortsova Square. Trolleybuses and a bus run to the terminal; you can also get there by taxi or private car.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: 5 km to the centre of Cheboksary. Trolleybuses No. 2 and No. 15, bus No. 15. Also taxi or private car.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Business lounge: stay of up to 2 hours for 4,000 ₽, via Every Lounge and Golden Key programmes, for Aeroflot Bonus Platinum and Gold members. Special service with check-in on Level 2: 5,500 ₽. VIP service for departure 15,250 ₽, for arrival 7,700 ₽, request 24 hours in advance. Entry to the lounge no earlier than 2 hours before departure.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Baggage storage: 300 ₽ per 1 item per day.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: The first 15 minutes are free. Cars: 100 ₽ per hour, 450 ₽ per day, from 3 days 400 ₽ per day. UAZ, Gazel, Sobol: 200 ₽ per hour, 650 ₽ per day. Lost receipt 500 ₽. Phone 8 (8352) 22-94-03, ext. 2-95.
